image_description: Three young adults (two males, one female) standing side-by-side wearing dark blue academic gowns with gold/yellow velvet panels and matching mortarboard caps. They are smiling at the camera against a light-colored brick wall background.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/chest level; the lower half of the garments and ankles are not visible, making full-length verification impossible.
The visible upper portions of the gowns show a clear vertical division down the center with symmetrical lapels/panels on either side.
The fabric hangs loosely around the shoulders and torso, hiding the specific shape of the bodies underneath, consistent with a voluminous cut.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subjects' arms are mostly obscured by their bodies or the frame edge; the sleeve ends and hands are not clearly visible to verify length relative to hands.
Distinctive colored panels (gold/yellow) are visible on the front chest area, acting as the decorative closure elements typical of this attire.
Collared shirts and ties are clearly visible at the necklines of all three subjects, indicating formal wear underneath.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears to be a shiny satin or synthetic blend rather than heavy matte wool/polyester. It reflects light significantly, especially on the folds.
Contradicts the previous point; the fabric has a noticeable sheen and specular highlights, indicating a reflective rather than non-reflective finish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Sleeve ends are not visible in the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Fabric surfaces of all three gowns
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fabric texture appears overly smooth and plastic-like with uniform specular highlights, lacking the fine weave detail expected of heavy academic wool or polyester blends. This suggests a generative smoothing artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Mortarboard caps (specifically the left and right subjects)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry of the caps is slightly warped. The brims do not maintain a rigid, flat plane; they appear to curve or melt into the hair/headline, particularly on the left subject where the cap edge blends softly into the forehead.
Slight blurring and indistinct boundaries between the shirt collars, ties, and the gown's inner lining. The layers do not separate cleanly, suggesting minor fusion of distinct clothing items.
